blocks.headline: Strategie: Artikel lernen
blocks.bodyEnglish:
A dictionary entry shows the article, the gender and the plural.
m means masculine, f means feminine and n means neuter.

blocks.explanationEnglish:
Learn every noun as one block: article, singular, plural.
The dictionary gives the block: das Krankenhaus, -es, die Krankenhäuser.
Every German noun starts with a capital letter: der Tag, die Woche.
m means masculine, f means feminine and n means neuter.
Trap: the article belongs to the word. ✗ Tag. → ✓ der Tag.
blocks.englishBridge: English nouns never change. German nouns carry article, gender, capital letter and plural inside the entry.
blocks.targetSentenceGerman: Der Computer ist neu. Das Buch ist gut.
blocks.targetSentenceEnglish: The computer is new. The book is good.

blocks.title: Das Artikelbild
blocks.bodyEnglish:
Draw one picture with many nouns.
Write each noun in the colour of its article.
der = blue, das = green, die = red.
The colour fixes the article in your memory.
blocks.bodyGerman:
der = blau
das = grün
die = rot

blocks.headline: Persönliche Angaben
blocks.bodyEnglish:
A form asks for your personal data.
Vorname is your first name and Familienname is your family name.

blocks.headline: Sportclub »Fit« — die Kurse
blocks.bodyGerman:
Basketball: Dienstag und Donnerstag, 19–21 Uhr
Fußball: Mittwoch, 20–21:30 Uhr
Karate: Montag, 18:30–20 Uhr
Tennis: Samstag, 15–17 Uhr
Yoga: Freitag, 18–20 Uhr
Zumba: Montag und Mittwoch, 10–11 Uhr
blocks.bodyEnglish: The sport club offers six courses. Each course has a weekday and a time. Choose one course, then fill in the form on the next page.

blocks.headline: Die Netzwerk-WG
blocks.bodyEnglish: Anna and Max look for a common sport. The dialogue repeats the hobbies, the yes/no question and the weekdays.

turns.speaker: Anna
turns.english: What do you like to do?

turns.speaker: Max
turns.german: Nein. Ich spiele gern Tennis und ich jogge.
turns.english: No. I like playing tennis and I jog.

turns.speaker: Anna
turns.german: Joggen ist super. Gehen wir zusammen?
turns.english: Jogging is great. Shall we go together?

blocks.title: Der Kurs-Tag
blocks.formula: Der [Kurs] ist am [Wochentag] von [Zeit] bis [Zeit] Uhr.
blocks.explanationEnglish: am + day names the weekday. von … bis … Uhr names the time of the course.

examples.german: Fußball ist am Mittwoch von 20 bis 21:30 Uhr.
examples.english: Football is on Wednesday from 8 to 9:30 pm.

examples.german: Tennis ist am Samstag von 15 bis 17 Uhr.
examples.english: Tennis is on Saturday from 3 to 5 pm.

blocks.prompt: Fill the correct article: der, das or die:
blocks.explanationEnglish: Computer is masculine: der. Rechnung is feminine: die. Buch is neuter: das. Learn each noun with its article.
The list says: Tennis, Samstag, 15–17 Uhr. Basketball is on Tuesday and Thursday, Yoga is on Friday.
